error.message: set-value did not take effect: after the write the element reads " ", not the requested value

nextSteps: Run `orca computer get-app-state --app <app> --json` and check which field holds the value; another field may have changed instead.

Do not retry the same `set-value` unchanged. For editable text, click the field and confirm focus, select all (`cmd+a` on macOS, `ctrl+a` on Windows/Linux), then use `type-text` and inspect the resulting value.
